description: One call for a project you do not know yet, or when something is broken and you do not know where to start: runs the review and, when Godot is installed, loads every script and scene with Godot; groups the findings by cause (twenty findings from one missing file are one problem), most urgent first, each with its place, the lesson that explains it, the fix, and whether godot_fix or godot_migrate can do it; then numbered next steps. Also returns the problems as JSON. `symptom` ("helicopter bounces on the moving deck") adds the lessons for what you see. It changes no project files (Godot updates its cache in .godot/). For the full list use godot_review; for Godot's raw output godot_check.

detail.description: brief (capped lists) or full (everything); default brief

files.description: only problems in these res:// files

godot.description: run Godot too when it is installed (default true)

path.description: project folder, or a file or folder inside it (relative to the server's folder; default: the current project)

symptom.description: what you see going wrong, in plain words

name: godot_doctor
title: What is wrong, and in which order to fix it
